Tooltip_HARMONIE_HomeCannedVegFruit: A home-canned jar of preserved vegetables or fruit, sealed with an empty tin can and salt. No printed label, just whatever you remember writing on the lid -- but it keeps indefinitely while sealed.
Tooltip_HARMONIE_HomeCannedVegFruitOpen: Home-canned vegetables or fruit, now open. Spoils like any other opened canned food. Retains whatever vitamins the original produce had.
Tooltip_HARMONIE_Multivitamin: A homemade multivitamin, ground from a carrot, an egg, an orange, a salmon fillet, peanuts, and kale -- one source of each vitamin your body needs. One dose covers a full day's worth of every vitamin at once.
